name: StreamV2V
license: UT Austin Research License (code); SD 1.5: CreativeML OpenRAIL-M; LCM-LoRA: OpenRAIL++; TAESD: MIT
notes: Streaming V2V with feature banks, configured as the upstream live-camera demo: SD 1.5 + LCM-LoRA + TAESD, t_index_list [30, 35, 40, 45], denoising batch, cached spatio-temporal attention (cache_interval 4, cache_maxframes 1, ToMe cache) with feature injection 0.8 / threshold 0.98; acceleration none (SDPA cached-attention processor) instead of xformers / TensorRT; demo style LoRAs not loaded. Each text_control instruction is sent verbatim as the new prompt (update_prompt from the next frame; feature bank kept; no rewriting or accumulation; CLIP truncates at 77 tokens). Output 640x384 (384x640 portrait, center crop) at up to 30 fps. Source frames are passed through until the first instruction. No reference path.
